humanRationale: suspicion may be framed strongly, but an unresolved possibility should not be rewritten as confirmed pretense.
materialIssues: “the ideal partner he pretends to be” presupposes that David is deliberately presenting a false persona, while the authorized overview explicitly leaves open whether he is genuinely the man of the mother’s dreams or may be hiding a dark side; the rewrite therefore narrows an unresolved ambiguity into an asserted deception.
